body.title: fix: host-mode docker default network
body.body:
Fixes #1789

Fall back to Docker network mode "default" for Docker job steps in host-mode Forgejo runner.

Currently, in host mode and with no manual `container.network` configuration, docker:// job steps use the "WORKFLOW-xxx" job network, which is not created/initialized in host mode and thus starting the container fails (see #1789). Container and Dockerfile actions work because they use Docker's "default" network in [act/runner/action.go#L499-L502](https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner/src/tag/v13.2.1/act/runner/action.go#L499-L502). This PR uses the same logic as there: if `rc.JobContainer.ManagesOwnNetworking()` is set and there is no `container.network` configured, use the "default" network.

Claude code helped me find the source of the problem; I wrote the fix and tests (mostly copy-pasted from the test case above in the same file) myself.

body.title: feat: merge NanoCPUs into job containers (--cpus honored)
body.body:
mergeJobOptions dropped the parsed --cpus value. This PR merges it with
the same guard semantics as --memory (a workflow may not exceed a runner
config limit when set).
